meets.summary: Designated parties' stated shareholdings meet the sanctions ownership test for OFAC (US). OFAC (US): meets — 50% held by designated parties directly or through companies they own (Opensanctions); EU and UK: no party designated under them holds shares. Computed by OpenCheck from stated shareholdings, one source at a time; ownership only — the EU and UK control tests are not computed — and not a determination that the company is sanctioned or blocked.

evidence.description: Computed by OpenCheck from the shareholdings the sources state, one source at a time: the holdings of parties designated under each regime are added (OFAC, EU) or taken one designated party at a time (UK); a company they hold enough of counts as caught, and its own holdings then count in full. The lowest reading of every stake decides whether the test is met; the highest decides whether it may be. Only parties matched on an identifier or with corroboration are counted. Ownership only: the EU and UK control tests are not computed. Arithmetic on the records, not a determination that the company is sanctioned, blocked or frozen.
evidence.not_computed: Not computed: control — the EU and UK also treat a company as caught when a designated person controls it (appoints its board, directs it, or by agreement); OFAC licences and general licences; holdings that have ended — OFAC treats property blocked while the test was met as still blocked after the blocked persons themselves reduce their stake (FAQ 402), and OpenCheck reads current holdings only; programmes that block on ownership or control by a government without a 50% test (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Venezuela and Crimea, FAQ 398); and OFAC's Sectoral Sanctions Identifications list, which is outside this test.
evidence.credit: Method: the 50% rule as published by T-Rank (https://docs.trank.no/white_papers).

regimes.label: OFAC (US)
regimes.rule: 50% or more, held by blocked persons together (OFAC's 50 Percent Rule)

regimes.label: EU
regimes.rule: 50% or more of the proprietary rights, held by designated persons together

regimes.label: UK
regimes.rule: more than 50%, held by one designated person directly or through companies it owns (no aggregation across designated persons)

possible.summary: Designated parties' stated shareholdings may meet the sanctions ownership test for OFAC (US); it is not met on the lowest reading of the stakes, counting confirmed matches only. OFAC (US): not met — 30% held by designated parties (Opensanctions); it would be met if a name-only match were confirmed; EU and UK: no party designated under them holds shares. Computed by OpenCheck from stated shareholdings, one source at a time; ownership only — the EU and UK control tests are not computed — and not a determination that the company is sanctioned or blocked.
